states.semantics: synthetic latent states or frozen u0-safe states only

molecular_values.semantics: synthetic molecular values or u0-safe Molecular Ledger values

measured_mask.semantics: physical measurement support; measured zero remains measured

known_molecular_reference_programs.semantics: prospectively supplied vectors only; annotations never define PCA directions

decomposition.fit: global mean-center states then economy SVD
decomposition.program_ids: D1A_PC001, D1A_PC002, ... in descending singular-value order

cell_score.tail_view: top/bottom 5 percent derived after full ranking; never a replacement for continuous scores

magnitude.point: sample SD of program cell scores
magnitude.interval: 95 percent donor-bootstrap percentile interval using fixed reference program scores

stability.axis: median absolute cosine to donor-bootstrap refitted/aligned axis
stability.split: mean reference-axis match across deterministic donor half-splits

estimation.donor_recurrence: fraction of donors represented in either derived 5 percent extreme tail
estimation.source_operator_heterogeneity: eta-squared of raw program scores by source/operator
estimation.measurement_support_score: R^2 between raw program score and per-cell measured-feature fraction
estimation.redundancy: maximum absolute cosine between molecular-association vectors of different programs
estimation.molecular_effect: Pearson correlation between donor-centered program score and donor-centered molecular value over physically measured cells
estimation.molecular_interval: 95 percent donor-bootstrap percentile interval for the molecular effect
estimation.molecular_donor_sign_recurrence: fraction of evaluable donors whose within-donor molecular correlation has the global effect sign
estimation.molecular_operator_sign_support: fraction of evaluable operators whose molecular correlation has the global effect sign

novelty.formula: 1 - maximum absolute cosine between the program molecular-effect vector and supplied known molecular reference vectors

state_direction_identity.representation: one row per program x canonical 160-D state coordinate
state_direction_identity.direction_sha256: SHA-256 of float64 C-order oriented component bytes
state_direction_identity.relationship_to_frozen_160d_basis: explicit signed loading on every canonical state coordinate; no coordinate is dropped

known_reference_relationship.program_level: report the supplied known molecular reference with maximum absolute cosine and the cosine value
known_reference_relationship.when_no_reference: reference ID null, cosine NaN, novelty NaN

ranked_hypothesis_catalog.description: deterministic measured-evidence summary from top positive/negative molecular features
ranked_hypothesis_catalog.purpose: synthetic prototype ranking only; not frozen as final real-D1 ranking formula

recovery: injected recurrent biological program must be recovered as a high-alignment state direction
full cell ranking must correlate strongly with injected biological score
injected molecular module must dominate positive/negative molecular associations
biological program must rank above a higher-variance measurement-support artifact after continuous artifact penalties
the recovered biological direction must be exported explicitly across all 160 canonical state coordinates
failure_and_falsification: measurement-support artifact must retain high measurement_support_r2/source heterogeneity rather than masquerade as clean biology
metadata permutation must not change fitted PCA directions or scores
no-signal/measurement-only fixture must not fabricate recovery of the absent injected biological direction
near-degenerate rotated axes may be axis-unstable while their subspace remains stable
dropping cells to tails instead of retaining full rankings is forbidden
real trained-teacher mode or protected-outcome metadata must be rejected
operator-level summaries must retain every observed operator rather than collapsing operators into source-only summaries

before_real_teacher_states: freeze exact real-D1 ranking/stability/selection formulas prospectively
bind mechanically healthy trained teacher checkpoint
bind exact discovery population and Molecular Ledger inputs
independent review of real-D1 execution package

fixed_prototype_parameters.donor_split_rule: sort unique donor IDs by SHA-256(seed || NUL || donor UTF-8), then alternate into A/B
fixed_prototype_parameters.effect_nan_rule: if fewer than 3 finite measured paired values or either paired variable has zero variance, effect and CI are NaN
fixed_prototype_parameters.cell_percentile_tie_break: ascending raw score, then canonical_cell_id; percentile=(ordinal_rank-1)/(n_cells-1), singleton=0.5

provenance.input_root_sha256: SHA-256 over length-prefixed canonical bytes in this order: algorithm_id, mode, float64 C-order states bytes plus shape, UTF-8 canonical metadata rows ordered as input, float64 C-order molecular bytes plus shape, uint8 C-order measured-mask bytes plus shape, ordered UTF-8 feature IDs, ordered known-reference IDs and float64 C-order vectors

supersedes.reason: Pre-implementation completeness review found that V1 omitted the explicit 160-D state-direction/loading output and full operator summary required by the parent D1 program. No D1-A implementation or synthetic known-answer outcome existed before this V2 repair.
